clear_saltmarket.name: First Night
clear_saltmarket.description: Knock down 8 of the crew on Saltmarket Street.

dialogue.offer: Ama's stall got shaken down again tonight. The crew ran off down Saltmarket Street, and they left a crate behind. Knock some sense into them.
dialogue.active: Saltmarket Street is east of the yard. Knock down 8 of them.
dialogue.done: They came back for that crate before I could open it. All I kept was this label. A factory stamp on a crate street punks fight over? Doesn't add up.

warden.name: The Canal Gate
warden.description: Defeat the Smog Warden guarding the way to Canal Works.

dialogue.offer: Men in gas masks have shut the gate to Canal Works. They're not police, not city. Get past whoever's in charge of them.
dialogue.active: The masked warden holds the far end of Saltmarket Street.
dialogue.done: No badge, no name, just orders. Somebody is paying good money to keep people out of those canals.

foreman.name: The Sludge Foreman
foreman.description: Defeat the Sludge Foreman at the end of Canal Works.

dialogue.offer: The canal stinks worse every night, and the boar-masked brute who runs the pumps is the reason. Shut him down.
dialogue.active: He works the pumps at the far end of Canal Works.
dialogue.done: A delivery note, stamped and signed for a warehouse that burned down years ago. Forged. They're moving freight through South Street on paper that can't be real.

glass_rain.name: Glass Rain
glass_rain.description: Knock down 6 Bottle Throwers on the Rusted Corner.

dialogue.offer: Since the Foreman went down, kids are lobbing bottles at anyone who walks the Rusted Corner. Somebody pays them to keep that road empty. Find out why.
dialogue.active: They keep their distance, so close it fast. Knock down 6 of them.
dialogue.done: One of them talked: paid per bottle, by a man who says he works for the refinery. Keep following the freight.

night_shift.name: Night Shift
night_shift.description: Knock down 5 Pipe Brutes in the Parking Lot.

dialogue.offer: The bottle kids said the refinery man parks his trucks in the car park past the Rusted Corner. Brutes with pipes guard the ramps. Knock down 5 and see what those trucks unload.
dialogue.active: The Parking Lot is past the Rusted Corner. Knock down 5 Pipe Brutes.
dialogue.done: They move the crates from the trucks onto freight wagons at night, straight to the rail yards. Same forged paper on every one.

rail_rumble.name: Rail Yard Rumble
rail_rumble.description: Knock down 8 Dock Thugs in the Rail Yards.

dialogue.offer: That forged note names the rail yards. Dock thugs are stripping the freight cars there. Put 8 of them on the ground and see what they're guarding.
dialogue.active: The Rail Yards are past the Parking Lot. Knock down 8 Dock Thugs.
dialogue.done: Empty cars, fresh tracks, and thugs who knew exactly which wagons to guard. Somebody gave them a schedule.

dialogue.offer: Punks run the Night Market after dark. Kenji at the noodle stall hears everything, but he won't talk while they're watching. Knock down 10 of them.
dialogue.active: The Night Market is past the Rail Yards. Knock down 10 punks.
dialogue.done: Kenji says the punks are paid by the Furnace Baron, up at the old refinery. He runs South Street now. Or thinks he does.

the_pit.name: The Pit
the_pit.description: Defeat the Pit Champion at the Fight Club.

dialogue.offer: Kenji says anyone who wants work at the refinery has to fight the Baron's champion first, in a ring in the alley behind the Night Market. The back door to the Baron runs through him.
dialogue.active: The Fight Club meets in the alley past the Night Market. Watch his wind-up; he hits like a truck.
dialogue.done: He fought for the Baron to clear his mother's debts. He's done with that now. The back door to the Refinery is open.

the_smelter.name: The Smelter
the_smelter.description: Knock down 5 Refinery Enforcers at the Smokestack Refinery.

dialogue.offer: The Baron melts stolen scrap in that refinery, and his enforcers run it for him. Break their hold on the smelter.
dialogue.active: The Smokestack Refinery is past the Fight Club. Knock down 5 enforcers.
dialogue.done: The furnace was still hot, but the Baron was gone, down a hatch into the drains. The Tar Rats nest down there, and they owe him.

rat_nest.name: Rat Nest
rat_nest.description: Knock down 12 Tar Rats in the Rat Nest.

dialogue.offer: The Tar Rats are hiding the Baron in the tunnels under the refinery. Go down after him. Knock down 12 of them and follow the tunnels to wherever he runs.
dialogue.active: The Rat Nest is through the refinery drains. Knock down 12 Tar Rats.
dialogue.done: The tunnels come up under a fortified building at the edge of the yards. Barred windows, guards on the gate. That's where he runs it all from.

furnace_baron.name: The Furnace Baron
furnace_baron.description: Defeat the Furnace Baron at the Gang Headquarters.

dialogue.offer: Every collection on this street is counted in that building. The Baron is inside with what's left of his crew. End it.
dialogue.active: The Gang Headquarters stand past the Rat Nest.
dialogue.done: His ledger. The same payment every week, from an account at the port, marked 'for the route'. The Baron was only renting this street. Somebody bigger is paying.

ends_chapter.title: Chapter 1 complete
ends_chapter.subtitle: South Street is safer. The money trail leads to the Port District.
